bias.en: Bearish · SAR flipped back, near the $203.6 October low
bias.zh: 看空 · SAR 重新转空，接近 10月低点 $203.6

read.en: Coherent fell 11.3% on Oct 30 to $210.32, trading between $203.87 and $222.62 on 1.6 times average volume, after the Oct 29 high stalled at $246.9. It is below the rising 5-day ($228.9), falling 10-day ($226.3), 30-day ($274.9) and 100-day ($305.2), and rising 200-day ($296.5) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Oct 30 ($246.90), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: Coherent 10月30日下跌 11.3%，收于 $210.32，盘中区间 $203.87–222.62，成交量为均量的 1.6 倍；此前 10月29日高点止步于 $246.9。股价位于上行的 5 日（$228.9）、下行的 10 日（$226.3）、30 日（$274.9）和 100 日（$305.2）以及上行的 200 日均线（$296.5）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下；抛物线 SAR 于 10月30日转为看空（$246.90），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, $232.5–236.9, $229.9 (10-day) and $222.3–222.8, now resistance. Resistance is $222.3–222.6 (Oct 27 low, Oct 30 high), then $226.3–228.9 (10 and 5-day) and $243–246.9 (Oct 28 high, SAR). Support is $203.6–203.9 (Oct 23 and Oct 30 lows), then $200.2 (Dec–Jan highs) and $183.6 (Dec 29 low). A close above $222.6 would target $226–229; below $203.6, $200.

r.en: Oct 28 high $243; Parabolic SAR and Oct 29 high $246.9
r.zh: 10月28日高点 $243；抛物线 SAR 及10月29日高点 $246.9

s.en: Dec 10 and Jan 5 highs ($200.2); $200 round number
